learn_edits.old: **Narrower scope.** The Commission proposed to take financial advisers and portfolio management out of the regulation.
learn_edits.new: **Same scope.** The proposal covers the same population of financial market participants and advisers as the current SFDR.
learn_edits.reason: The curated data states that the scope is the same population as the SFDR, contradicting the learning page's claim of a narrower scope.
